assertion.statement: A geometrically integral nonconical cubic hypersurface with a rational point is unirational over its characteristic-zero field.
assertion.objects: X in projective n-space over k and a dominant rational parametrization.
assertion.hypotheses: Characteristic zero; n>=3; geometric integrality; noncone; X(k) nonempty.
assertion.quantifiers: For every such k and X.
assertion.parameter_range: Dimension at least two; applied only over Q.
assertion.uniformity: The assertion applies to each object satisfying the stated hypotheses; no uniform effective bound is used.
assertion.constants: No quantitative constant is supplied or changed.
assertion.normalizations: Cone means a projective vertex after scalar extension; rational points need not be smooth.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Singular rational points and codimension-one singular loci are included. Plane cubics and cones are excluded.
